name: Axiom Systems Portable SIGINT Station PSS-2
product_name: Axiom Systems Portable SIGINT Station PSS-2
description: A compact signals intelligence platform that intercepts, decrypts, and analyzes all wireless communications within a 500-meter radius. The PSS-2 captures radio, cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Diaspora traffic simultaneously, running real-time decryption against commercial-grade encryption while logging traffic for later analysis of harder targets. The station can identify and track individual devices, map communication networks, and extract content from unencrypted or weakly encrypted channels. Axiom designed it for field intelligence operations.
story_hooks: A PSS-2 deployed near a corporate negotiation captured the entire opposing team's communications — including their bottom-line position, their strategy, and their personal messages, giving the deploying party total information advantage.
A PSS-2 has been found permanently installed in a Tier 3 cafe, capturing all wireless traffic from every patron — the cafe is a front for an intelligence operation that has been running for years.

physical_description.visual_profile: A ruggedized briefcase-sized SIGINT platform with a modular top-mounted antenna array. The unit presents as a utilitarian black case with integrated cooling vents and a deployable screen assembly that folds up from the main housing. Multiple antenna connectors protrude from reinforced mounting points, suggesting serious RF collection capability.
physical_description.dimensions: 42cm W × 28cm D × 16cm H (closed); antenna mast extends 35cm when deployed
physical_description.weight_description: 2 kg—handheld but designed for sustained carrying with an integrated shoulder strap and reinforced carry handles
physical_description.primary_material: Aluminum composite chassis with rubberized polymer edge cladding; stainless steel antenna mounts
physical_description.finish: Matte black anodized aluminum with non-reflective black urethane coating on panels; textured grip surfaces on handles
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal-black primary with gunmetal gray antenna hardware; accent LEDs in cold blue and warning amber
physical_description.interface_elements: 8-inch flexible OLED screen (recesses into top panel when folded), 12-button membrane keypad with haptic feedback, 6 SMA RF connectors, USB-C data port, power button, mode selector dial, three status LED clusters (signal/lock/recording), small cooling grille on right side
distinctive_features: Modular antenna array with three telescoping elements that deploy vertically from spring-loaded mounts
Recessed OLED screen with anti-glare coating that folds flush into briefcase lid
Heat-dissipation fins on left panel indicating active cooling systems
Axiom Systems proprietary RF shielding seals around panel edges (visible as thin metallic gaskets)
Dual-mode carrying system: briefcase handles + quick-release shoulder strap with carabiners
Subtle scanning-pattern etching on top panel—a geometric wave design that catches light
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: AXIOM SYSTEMS logo embossed on top (silver); 'PSS-2 PORTABLE SIGINT STATION' stenciled on right side in small military-style lettering; regulatory compliance stamps and CE marking on back panel; laser-etched serial number on bottom
physical_description.condition_typical: In field use: antenna array deployed vertically, OLED screen tilted up at 60° angle, blue signal-lock LED illuminated, faint cooling fan hum audible, carrying strap worn over operator's shoulder with excess cable looped through connector ports

image_prompt: A Axiom Systems PSS-2 SIGINT station lies open on a weathered steel workbench in a dimly lit safehouse. The briefcase-sized black unit has three antenna masts deployed vertically, emitting a subtle blue glow from indicator LEDs. The recessed OLED screen displays streaming RF traffic in cyan waveforms. Dramatic side-lighting from a single work lamp casts sharp shadows across the antenna hardware. Urban cyberpunk setting, neon blue accent lighting reflecting off the matte black chassis, scattered network cables and RF connectors nearby, depth of field with blurred bokeh of GLMZ city lights through a nearby window.
